translations.web: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?
translations.bsb: So they asked Him, “What sign then will You perform, so that we may see it and believe You? What will You do?
translations.kjv: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
translations.asv: They said therefore unto him, What then doest thou for a sign, that we may see, and believe thee? what workest thou?
